requested_change: Add an integration-owned deterministic binary asset materializer for the authorized T05 visual repair branch.
reason: T05 station GLBs are deterministic generated binary outputs. Exact-source visual evidence requires the regenerated GLBs to be committed before the final precritic run, while the candidate branch must not gain general repository-write authority.
dependency: The materializer reads repair authorization only from the current integration branch and requires the repair head to contain that integration head.
expected_behavior: On the exact T05 repair branch, regenerate station assets, verify deterministic source integrity, permit only stations_v2 GLB/catalog output changes, confirm the remote branch has not moved, and commit only those generated outputs. No-op when generated bytes are already committed.
tests_required: Reject a repair branch that does not contain current integration authorization.
Reject missing/mismatched ACTIVE T05 visual invalidation.
Reject any generated or staged path outside HavenlineGodot/assets/stations_v2/*.glb and catalog.json.
Reject a moved remote branch before writing.
Second run must be a deterministic no-op after materialization.
authorization: User approved the T05 production-art rebuild. This integration-owned utility is authorized only to materialize deterministic T05 generated asset outputs so exact-source evidence can run on committed bytes.
forbidden_changes: No gameplay, sockets, footprints, critic thresholds or lifecycle changes.
No file outside the deterministic T05 stations_v2 output directory.
